sequence_points.name: Abstract Vertical Composition in Grays
sequence_points.description: A monochromatic abstract painting featuring vertical bands of varying shades of gray and black, with textured brushwork creating a layered effect. The artwork is mounted on a wall, displayed in a minimalist setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Monochrome Panel
sequence_points.description: A large, vertically oriented abstract painting featuring a muted gray and black color palette with a central dark vertical band. The surface appears textured with subtle gradations and layered marks, mounted on a plain wall in a gallery setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Vertical Panels
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring a composition of rectangular panels in muted earth tones, grays, and blues. The artwork appears mounted on a wall, with visible texture and layered brushwork suggesting a mixed-media or collage technique.
